goals.title: Raise a stone arch with a crane the friends walk
goals.critique: This is round 18's treadwheel crane again, and the rework answers its faults: the friction-stacked tower becomes an arch that stands or falls by its own shape when the props go, a real bet with a held breath at the end, and the scripted distractions become friends you steer with food you hang for them, so you read them rather than wait on them. The weak side is that the pitch now carries two big machines, and the arch rests on what physics engines do worst, many rigid stones holding on each other by friction without jitter or creep; if the solver lets a good arch sag or a bad one hold, the payoff is a lie. A carrot on a stick is an old gag, chipping wedges to fit by mouse is untested, and an arch that quietly holds is gentler to clip than the span dropping into the stream, which is the clip people would actually send.
